propositions: Outbound differ reads raw vendor snapshot keys instead of canonicalizing them via InboundMapper before comparison, creating asymmetry with inbound differ which already compares canonical shapes

Outbound field comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches) keep vendor-shaped logic in core, violating the port seam principle (ADR 0035 §(d)) that forbids core from consuming vendor snapshot dicts

Snapshot entry must be canonicalized at ingestion boundary via injected inbound_mapper.map_remote_to_local before field/label/baseline comparison, and vendor update payload emitted only via injected OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote at emission boundary

InboundMapper output must be widened with canonical keys (assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity) supporting neutral field comparison logic, while OutboundMapper gains resolve_assignee to re-home the assignee resolver with its sentinel contract intact

Partial _BASELINE_FIELDS dict must map through map_remote_to_local with presence-guarded output (absent vendor key yields absent canonical key, never a default) while full snapshot maps byte-identically to today

Characterization suite must prove old-vs-new decision equivalence across status/priority maps, assignee shapes, parent changes, description ADF fit, baseline suppression, and resolver fallback before vendor helpers are demoted to adapter-internal
